subject: general
question:
Q started from a point and walked towards the south for 42 m and reached point A. Q then turned right from point A and walked 2 m, he then turned right again and walked 30 m. Q turned left now and walked 10 m, he then turned left again and walked 30 m. How far is Q from point A?

(All turns are 90 degree turn only)
solution:
Drawing figure as per given information as,

 
• Q started from a point and walked towards the south for 42 m and reached point A.
 
• Q then turned right from point A and walked 2 m, 
 
• he then turned right again and walked 30 m. 
 
• Q turned left now and walked 10 m, 
 
• he then turned left again and walked 30 m. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/579605421b80b2ce1252e72c3157b71de988302a203afda3dc0387f7c8642268.png] 

Here, **12m** far is Q from point A.

**Hence, '12 m' is the correct answer.**
